title: Read is not cited — five pages read, one page the answer rests on
summary: sources[] lists every page a job read; cited: true marks the ones the answer used. They differ, and pages_read is not evidence. Measured with discover seed and max_pages 5 on a pricing question at https://plausible.io/: 5 pages read, 1 cited — the homepage carried the three plans; the other four were feature pages whose URLs matched the question's words. The answer's source_url values pointed at that one page and every one was on it (answer_urls.ungrounded would have been empty). Quote the cited sources, say how many pages were read, and check answer_urls.ungrounded before quoting any URL from the answer itself.
references: SpiderIQ card SPI6-10 — live run on 2026-09-28 inside the SpiderSite worker image: discover seed, max_pages 5, start https://plausible.io/, question 'What pricing plans are there and what does each cost per month?' → 3 tiers (Starter, Business, Enterprise), each with source_url https://plausible.io/; 5 pages read, 1 cited; 5,069 tokens; 13.6 s
